disputes.reason: The statement is clearly false, but its correction keeps the unsupported claim that supply-side forces drove AI adoption until 2017. The FSB says both sides were examined in 2017, so the correction is not itself true.

The statement is hedged with 'could', so it is not clearly false: a candidate can argue that GenAI could make risk analysis less standardised, for example through model-specific outputs and hallucinations. The reading only says GenAI enables more standardised analyses.
